info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Refunds-v2-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Refunds Retrieval API provides a mechanism for consumers to access detailed information regarding refunds associated with retail orders. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of refunds, facilitating better tracking and management of retail transactions. Typical consumers include retail managers and financial analysts seeking to analyze refund trends or resolve customer inquiries. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve customer service related to order refunds.

get.summary: Retrieve refund details for an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of refunds associated with a specific order. You can obtain information such as the refund status, refund amount, and other relevant details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund process for the specified order. It should include all necessary details such as the order ID and refund amount to ensure a proper transaction.
